entries.text: Heh... Ever get that itch? The one that whispers, "What if I just... walked away?" Just..."poof"...gone. You know, switch sides, see how the others live.
entries.raw: §7§oHeh... Ever get that itch? The one that whispers, "What if I just... walked away?" Just..."poof"...gone. You know, switch sides, see how the others live.
entries.zh: 嘿……有没有过这种冲动? 心里有个声音悄悄说: 要不……就这么走了? 然后，噗，人就不见了。你懂的，换个阵营，看看别人怎么过日子。

entries.context: 离开城市派系按钮斜体诱惑文案第二叙述单元，同次第5至15行；保留劝诱口吻不添加机制
entries.text: It's not betrayal, not really. More like... expanding horizons. Maybe they don't appreciate you here. Maybe the grass is greener in another faction. Or... maybe you just want to watch the world burn a little, shake things up. I'm just saying... they wouldn't even see it coming. You could do it. You could leave them behind like they were never anything to you. Mmh... just think about it.

entries.zh: 这不算背叛，真的。顶多算……开阔眼界。也许这里根本没人赏识你，也许别的派系才有好日子。又或者……你只是想添把火，搅搅局。我只是说说……他们绝对料不到。你做得到，把他们抛在身后，就当从来没在乎过。嗯……好好想想。
